excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
Well, we still need to agree on whether we _want_ to do the switch to SSZ.
The existing `newPayload` and `getPayload` APIs would only need to change, if we decide to put RLP roots into the ExecutionPayload (option C in pdf).
With the other approaches, no changes are necessary to the existing APIs.

An additional API to put just the `ExecutionPayloadHeader`, or just a sync context, may be introduced that lives on the side of `newPayload` / `getPayload` for use by light clients. These could be added later though (even post Capella upgrade) — https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/318 currently shows how that could look  like. But again, pending discussion on which approach will win 🙂
